onebot_delivery.title: OneBot Forwarded Messages
onebot_delivery.hint: Only for OneBot v11 (aiocqhttp). Ordinary replies exceeding the text threshold are packaged as forwarded messages.

effects.streamingDecoration: Streaming replies are enabled: this setting is skipped during actual streaming delivery. It still applies to ordinary replies and replies that fall back to ordinary delivery.
effects.streamingSafety: Streaming replies are enabled: actual streaming delivery bypasses reply content checks. Checks apply after fallback to ordinary delivery.
effects.streamingBuffer: Streaming replies are enabled: Agent intermediate messages are merged only during non-streaming execution. Streaming execution and its ordinary-delivery fallback do not use this merge.
effects.streamingPlatform: Streaming replies are enabled: actual streaming delivery bypasses generic mentions and quotes; their display depends on the platform adapter.
effects.voiceBeforeImage: Speech replies are enabled: an AI reply that triggers speech skips text-to-image, even with simultaneous text output. Replies that do not trigger speech still follow image rules.
effects.voiceReasoning: Speech replies are enabled: an AI reply that triggers speech omits reasoning, even with simultaneous text output.
effects.voiceDecoration: Speech replies are enabled: replies containing audio bypass generic mentions and quotes, including simultaneous speech and text output.
effects.imageBeforeSegments: Text-to-image is enabled: when a reply is successfully rendered as an image, its text segments become one image instead of separate text messages.
effects.forwardBeforeSegments: Segmented replies are enabled: OneBot replies exceeding the forward threshold package all segments into a forwarded message instead of sending them separately.
effects.forwardDecoration: OneBot replies exceeding the forward threshold bypass generic mentions and quotes.
